findings.title: Errors: 3 spans with status ERROR, 3 exception events

findings.evidence: status.code = ERROR on the span; exception = span events named 'exception' (*errors.errorString). Where an errored span has children, the deepest span on its critical path is named as the place its time went (a locus, not a cause).

findings.title: Retries: 3 re-runs after an error, 3 retry events
findings.text: redis-manual / GetDriver failed at +350.4 ms, re-run at +379.8 ms with the same param.driverID=T713723C; redis-manual / GetDriver failed at +430.3 ms, re-run at +463.9 ms with the same param.driverID=T775101C; redis-manual / GetDriver failed at +509.1 ms, re-run at +539.7 ms with the same param.driverID=T737227C
findings.evidence: re-run = the next sibling with the same service, name and identifying attributes (param., db.query.text, db.statement, url.full, http.url, rpc.method, messaging.destination.name) starting after the errored span ended; retry events = events whose name matches 'retry' (Retrying GetDriver after error on driver / driver.DriverService/FindNearest).

findings.title: Fan-out: 13 x redis-manual / GetDriver, serial
findings.text: 13 x redis-manual / GetDriver under driver / driver.DriverService/FindNearest (f6e63a82): serial: no two overlap, so each call waits for the last (N+1 shape); wall 206.0 ms, sum of durations 205.7 ms; 11 x frontend / HTTP GET under frontend / GET /dispatch (9c3834fb): serial: no two overlap, so each call waits for the last (N+1 shape); wall 1116.6 ms, sum of durations 871.2 ms
findings.evidence: siblings grouped by (service, name) under one parent, groups of 3 or more; overlap = largest number of the group's intervals open at one instant. Widest parent overall: 14 children.
